info.title: ha-power
info.description: The routes examples/ha-power serves. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns, and the host serves this document rebased under it at <mount>/openapi.json.

PowerState.description: What Home Assistant says about the plug of one printer.

on.description: True when the plug is on.

available.description: False when Home Assistant reports the plug as unavailable. The plug cannot be switched then.

entity.description: The Home Assistant entity the printer is mapped to, such as switch.mk4_plug.

PowerRequest.description: The state a person asks the plug to take.

on.description: True turns the plug on and false turns it off.

PowerAnswer.description: The state the plug was asked to take, once Home Assistant accepted the call.

on.description: The state that was asked for.

Refusal.description: One refusal, as RFC 9457 names it. The client SDK reads this shape: code reaches ApiError.code and detail reaches ApiError.message.

type.description: about:blank, because this module publishes no page per code.

status.description: The HTTP status, repeated in the body.

code.description: The module's own code, such as ha-power/NOT_MAPPED. It is outside the core's registry.

title.description: What went wrong, in one phrase that never varies.

detail.description: What went wrong this time. It never holds the token.

retryable.description: Whether sending the same request again could work.

Refused.description: The module refused the call. The status says which rule it met.

get.summary: The state of a printer's plug
get.description: Reads the plug the printer is mapped to from Home Assistant. A printer with no entry in the switches setting is refused with 404 and the code ha-power/NOT_MAPPED. A failure of Home Assistant is refused with 502. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.

post.summary: Turn a printer's plug on or off
post.description: Calls switch.turn_on or switch.turn_off in Home Assistant for the entity the printer is mapped to. The caller never names an entity. A printer with no entry in the switches setting is refused with 404. Turning off is refused with 409 while the printer is PRINTING, PAUSED or BUSY (ha-power/PRINTER_BUSY) or its nozzle is hotter than 50 degrees (ha-power/NOZZLE_HOT), and with 503 when the printer's state cannot be read (ha-power/STATE_UNREADABLE). The host takes operate_resource on the module's instance before this is called.
